text: Jordan's design review turned into a public dismantling when Marcus rejected the dashboard layout over a "direction" he'd never actually communicated, brushing off Lena's attempt to defend Jordan too. Afterward Jordan withdrew completely—lying to Marcus about a headache, avoiding Mika, sitting alone in the dark for hours without eating, recognizing this as a familiar shutdown pattern triggered by criticism and feeling unseen. No real decisions were made beyond naming the pattern; Jordan went to bed early, comforted only by Pepper sensing something was wrong.
